title: Ever been to the lavander mall?
content: Here's a dream I had a while ago. I was on a subway on my way to the mall. On my way there, there were these cute little boutique that had docking ports where you can get off and go inside. We arrived at one. The floor was wooden and there were displays of tops, pants, etc. When you exited the store, you enter the actual mall. The walls are painted lavander. It's usually busy, and the music that plays is pleasant and you become at ease as if all your worries went away. The mall isn't that much different from other males. It's two stories tall and stores line the sides of the walls. One door leads to a lobby of some kind with various closed doors. In this dream of mines, I was with a guy I was dating in the dream and we opened one of these doors. It was a college lecture hall, and his mother was a college professor giving a speech on chemistry. I dunno I've had mall dreams before but I could never pick up on this sense of euphoria when I entered this one.
